title: TMC Leaders and Supporters Protest in Kolkata Over Alleged Residence Attack
seoTitle: Kolkata TMC protest over residence attack

tea.why: Protesters and leaders demonstrated following an overnight clash and an alleged attack on a party leader's residence.
tea.want: Action against alleged attackers and accountability for the breakdown of local law and order.
tea.changed: Nov 8, 2026: Mamata Banerjee joined the demonstration in Kalighat, accused the BJP of hooliganism, and wrote to the Lok Sabha Speaker.

summary: Trinamool Congress (TMC) supporters and leaders gathered in Kolkata's Kalighat area to protest following an overnight confrontation and an alleged attack on the residence of national general secretary Abhishek Banerjee. Former West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee joined the demonstration, accusing the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of orchestrating hooliganism, disrupting local Kali Puja and Diwali preparations, and causing a breakdown of law and order. According to reports, clashes had erupted between TMC workers and BJP supporters outside the residence. Protesters raised slogans against the police outside the premises, expressing anger over the incident and alleged police inaction. A large police contingent was deployed to seal off the area, and authorities imposed prohibitory restrictions while detaining several individuals.
demands: Action against those responsible for the alleged attack
Restoration of local law and order
response: A large police contingent was deployed to seal off the area, and several individuals were detained following the overnight clashes. The BJP rejected the allegations, blaming the confrontation on a birthday gathering organized on a public road.

arrests.text: Police detained several people in connection with the clashes.

injuries.text: At least eight people were reportedly injured, three of them seriously.

updates.text: Clashes and an alleged attack occurred outside the residence of a TMC leader around 2:00 AM.
Mamata Banerjee joined the protest in Kalighat and wrote to the Lok Sabha Speaker regarding law and order.
